title: Action associated to a case
statement: For a machine $M$ and a case $q$, associate the machine action for the state and scanned symbols recorded by $q$ when its state is present. If its state is absent, the associated action has zero input-head movement, zero movement on every work tape, no writes, no output, and no successor state.
